sloka: एतत्तदुक्तमव्यक्तमक्षरं ब्रह्मनिर्मितम् ।देवानां हृदयं सौम्य गुह्यं रामः परन्तपः ।। ६.१२२.३२ ।।
transliteration: etattaduktamavyaktamakṣaraṁ brahmanirmitam ।devānāṁ hṛdayaṁ saumya guhyaṁ rāmaḥ parantapaḥ ।। 6.122.32 ।।

translations.english: "O Gentle! Rama, the tormentor of enemies is the unmanifest and imperishable secret, is Brahma alone. This is created by Brahma. It is the secret in the heart of gods."
